title: Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads

translated_title: 无监督多模态奖励建模
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言奖励模型通常在标注的偏好对上进行训练，这类数据收集成本高昂、标注可能相互矛盾，且模型往往仅以基准测试准确率来评判排名。我们构建了一个无需任何人类偏好标签的奖励模型：在冻结的 Qwen3-VL 骨干网络的中间层之上加一个线性头，通过训练使其对网络爬取的原始图注的打分高于同一图注的扰动版本；标注数据仅用于选择层。层的选择是决定性因素，相比使用最后一层可带来 5.8 分的提升；在 32B 模型上，一套无需重新调参即可直接迁移的配方在三个基准上超越或至少持平 GPT-4o，在 VL-RewardBench 上领先 6.6 分，而这一切仅依赖数千个参数和大约千分之一的微调计算量。在相同的配对数据预算下，扰动方法比精心筛选的 RLAIF-V 数据对多教会冻结头 3 到 5 分。由于骨干网络被冻结，目标函数是凸的，且扰动采样器本身即定义了奖励——这是基准测试无法识别的：两个头
tldr: 提出一种无需人类偏好标签的无监督多模态奖励建模方法，通过在冻结的 Qwen3-VL 中间层训练线性头来区分网络图注与其扰动版本，仅用数千参数和约千分之一的微调计算量即可在多个基准上超越或持平 GPT-4o。
en_tdlr: An unsupervised multimodal reward model is built by training a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone to prefer web captions over their perturbed versions, matching or beating GPT-4o on benchmarks with only a few thousand parameters and a thousandth of fine-tuning compute.
